description: Verify that the Port Number field of the IPv4 Endpoint Option (UDP) is service UDP port (SOME/IP-SD §5.1.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Wire-format invariant for the IPv4 Endpoint Option (UDP): Port Number == service UDP port.

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT emits a qualifying SD message containing the option (typically an OfferService).
Observation: option's Port Number field == service UDP port.   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Port Number on the wire equals service UDP port.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_port — IPv4 endpoint UDP port mismatch
• Fail_timeout — no qualifying SD message within listen window

verdicts.Pass: IPv4 Endpoint Option (UDP) Port Number = service UDP port — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying SD message within listen window
